attBesluta.text: Perfecto, muy bien protegido y recibido antes de la fecha de entrega que ponían.

Shipping was excellent the product was easily installed with some math skills involved because its through the wall and drywall inside and a 45° down slope. Light security locking mechanism. Hardware was included. For what I needed, 5 star.

I’ve had this mailbox installed for months and it still looks and works like new. The slot is wide enough for letters, magazines, small parcels, and even rent checks. The viewing window lets me check contents without opening the door, which is super convenient. The adjustable chute works with different wall thicknesses, making installation flexible. The rubber padding and drainage holes at the bottom prevent water buildup. Very reliable and low-maintenance.
Producto de calidad perfectamente empaquetado y protegido. Recibido el plazo.

This drop box is versatile enough for both residential and commercial use. I use it at my small office for incoming mail and after-hours document drops. The large storage space holds multiple envelopes and small packages, and the weatherproof design keeps everything clean and dry. The locking system is reliable, and the durable construction gives me peace of mind. Highly recommend for anyone needing secure deposit storage.
Uma caixa de correio com uma boa relação qualidade preço. Peça pela fraca pintura, que ao fim de 1 ano já apresenta diversos pontos de ferrugem.
This organizer was a great purchase. It seems to be well constructed and sturdy. It went together in a flash and has plenty of storage room.
It is made of premium\-quality materials, exactly what I was looking for. Thank you for the excellent service and outstanding quality. I truly appreciate it.

I'm very happy with this set of toolholders, my second set. THIS IS IMPORTANT - many other toolholders are only 25mm thick. These toolholders are more than 30mm thick. I bought the thinner ones from another place and found that the whole assembly flexed when I clamped a tool. It was so bad that I couldn't install it on the toolpost. The Vevor ones are much stiffer, work great and are truly interchangeable. Well done Vevor!

Works great. You might need to make a shim to go inside where the bolt goes, so don't take your lathe apart until after you make it. You'll need your lathe to make the part. It's also a little bulky, so you will lose some width on what you can cut because the tool will be closer to the chuck after installing this. Other than that, its awesome having the ability to quickly change tools.
Un produs excelent, de calitate si foarte bine finisat. Din pacate este mare pentru strungul meu. Sunt nevoit sa-l returnez.
